attchmntText: Mamata Machinery Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Mamata Machinery Limited has announced an earnings conference call scheduled for Tuesday, November 17, 2026, at 11:00 A.M. IST. The call will discuss financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Management participants include Rajashekar Venkat, Chief Executive Officer, and Apurva Kane, Strategic Consultant. Madhuri Sharma serves as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The audio recording and transcript will be posted on the company website after the call.

attchmntText: Mamata Machinery Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Mamata Machinery Limited filed a notice regarding the publication of newspaper advertisements for its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The advertisements were published in Financial Express and Jai Hind Publication on November 08, 2026. This disclosure complies with Regulation 30 and 47(3) of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The information is also available on the company website at www.mamata.com.

attchmntText: Mamata Machinery Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Mamata Machinery Limited filed an earnings presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. Consolidated revenue from operations for Q2FY27 was 4,105 IN ₹ LAKHS, a 23% year-over-year decline. Half-year revenue was 7,732 IN ₹ LAKHS, a 16% year-over-year decline. The company reported an EBITDA loss of 555 IN ₹ LAKHS for H1FY27, compared to an EBITDA of 987 IN ₹ LAKHS in H1FY26. Profit after tax for H1FY27 was a loss of 452 IN ₹ LAKHS, versus a profit of 718 IN ₹ LAKHS in H1FY26. Management cited elevated crude oil and polymer prices, customer working capital strain, and a five-day plant shutdown due to flooding as factors affecting execution. The company stated it expects to achieve FY27 revenue on par with FY26 through higher execution in the second half.

attchmntText: Mamata Machinery Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Mamata Machinery Limited has approved the unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors considered these results along with the Auditors’ Limited Review Report during a meeting held on November 07, 2026. The meeting commenced at 10:00 A.M. IST and concluded at 11:15 A.M. IST. The financial results and the Auditors’ Limited Review Report are enclosed with the announcement.
